opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Undergraduate Tuition Fee Grants

amount.raw: Grants cover the cost of tuition fees, up to £1,820 per year for a full-time degree course

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals from low-income households who are ineligible for tuition fee support from the Scottish Government; ordinarily resident in Scotland (with at least two years of secondary schooling/college in Scotland or a substantial recent connection); entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK, hold Limited Leave to Remain for the course duration, or be an asylum seeker; enrolled on an undergraduate degree course at an eligible Scottish higher education institution.
opportunities.summary: Grants covering the cost of tuition fees (up to £1,820 per year) for undergraduate degree students at Scottish higher education institutions who are not eligible for government funding for their tuition fees. Applications processed on a first-come-first-served basis.

opportunities.funder: Carnegie Trust for the Universities of Scotland
opportunities.title: Carnegie-Morgan Scholarship

amount.raw: Full tuition fees for the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants plus an additional living-cost bursary of £1,200

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scottish-domiciled students from low-income households who have been accepted onto the MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants (delivered by the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh and the University of Edinburgh); ordinarily resident in Scotland; entitled to remain indefinitely in the UK; not already holding a postgraduate degree.
opportunities.summary: Scholarship developed in partnership with the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh covering full tuition fees and a £1,200 living-cost bursary for postgraduate study in plant science and botany (MSc in Biodiversity and Taxonomy of Plants), aimed at widening participation in postgraduate study and supporting Scotland's net-zero and biodiversity workforce.
